name: Vegetable Millet Casserole
ingredients: 1 carrot, 1 zucchini and 1 cup spinach, chopped
1 cup unsweetened soy milk, 1 cup vegetable stock
steps: Sauté the onion, garlic and carrot in the oil for 5 minutes.
Mix with the millet, beans, zucchini, spinach, thyme, nutritional yeast and seasoning in a baking dish.
Pour in the soy milk and stock and cover with foil.
Bake for 40 minutes until the millet is tender and the liquid absorbed.
note: Millets keep this casserole higher in fibre than a rice-based bake.
